**Venezuela, Bolivarian Republic of: how applications changed.** The extract records 2,385,750 applications during 2000–2025. Annual volume peaked at 440,805 in 2019, compared with 309,891 in 2025. Applications in 2025 were 30% lower than in 2019 (440,805). Applications in 2025 were 13% higher than in 2024 (273,298). In 2025, the leading destinations were United States (141,616; 46%), Spain (85,413; 28%), Brazil (21,233; 6.9%). United States received 46% of this origin's applications in 2025, versus 8.1% in 2019: a change in destination distribution, not evidence that the same people moved between asylum systems.

Across receiving countries, in 2025, the substantive protection rate was 80%, across 92,348 grants and refusals; closures accounted for 43% of all recorded decisions. That protection rate was 1.1 percentage points lower than in 2024 (81%).
